description: This file contains a unit test class for the CustomFieldService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods of the service class, including DAO retrieval, getter/setter generation, field extraction, and delete logic related to custom employee fields.

classes.name: CustomFieldServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing methods of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Verifies that getCustomFieldDao() returns an instance of CustomFieldDao.

methods.name: testGenerateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests the generation of getter method names based on field numbers.

methods.name: testGenerateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Tests the generation of a field key string from a field ID.

methods.name: testGenerateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Tests the generation of a setter method name based on a field key.

methods.name: testExtractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Validates extraction of field numbers from field key strings.

methods.name: testGetAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all custom fields currently in use, mocking the DAO responses.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenNotDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests the deletion logic for custom fields' extra data when the delete option is not selected.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests the deletion logic for custom fields' extra data when the delete option is selected.
